title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy frame-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
description: The frame-src directive permits plaintext HTTP frames, so a framed document can be rewritten in transit into attacker-controlled content inside the trusted page.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit frame-src directive.
risk: Injected markup that today renders a harmless frame becomes a phishing surface inside the origin; MEDIUM because the frame still cannot read the parent document.
